local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local NAMESPACE = "Forge_98c63e12b73c"

local root = workspace:WaitForChild(NAMESPACE)
local world = root:WaitForChild("World")
local butter = world:WaitForChild("Butter")
local clickDetector = butter:WaitForChild("ClickDetector")
local assets = root:WaitForChild("Assets")
local crunchSound = assets:WaitForChild("crunchAudio")
local crunchCount = world:WaitForChild("CrunchCount")

crunchSound.Parent = butter
crunchSound.Volume = 0.75

local originalSize = butter.Size
local originalPos = butter.Position

local isCrunching = false
local lastCrunchTime = {}
local COOLDOWN = 1.5

local function performCrunch(player: Player)
	if isCrunching then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local lastTime = lastCrunchTime[player.UserId] or 0
	if now - lastTime < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end

	-- Validate character and distance
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return
	end
	local distance = (hrp.Position - butter.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > 15 then
		return
	end

	lastCrunchTime[player.UserId] = now
	isCrunching = true

	-- Increment counter
	crunchCount.Value = crunchCount.Value + 1

	-- Play sound
	crunchSound:Play()

	-- Squash animation
	local squashSize = Vector3.new(1.9, 0.28, 2.7)
	local squashY = 3.9 + 0.14
	local squashPos = Vector3.new(0, squashY, 0)

	local squashTween = TweenService:Create(butter, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = squashSize,
		Position = squashPos
	})
	squashTween:Play()

	task.wait(0.18)

	-- Recover animation
	local recoverTween = TweenService:Create(butter, TweenInfo.new(0.75, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = originalSize,
		Position = originalPos
	})
	recoverTween:Play()

	task.wait(0.75)

	isCrunching = false
end

clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(performCrunch)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastCrunchTime[player.UserId] = nil
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local root = workspace:WaitForChild("Forge_98c63e12b73c")
local world = root:WaitForChild("World")
local butter = world:WaitForChild("Butter")
local crunchCount = world:WaitForChild("CrunchCount")

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local guiFolder = playerGui:WaitForChild("Forge_98c63e12b73c")
local screenGui = guiFolder:WaitForChild("CrunchScreenGui")
local counterFrame = screenGui:WaitForChild("CounterFrame")
local counterLabel = counterFrame:WaitForChild("CounterLabel")

local function updateCounter()
	counterLabel.Text = tostring(crunchCount.Value)
	local popTween = TweenService:Create(counterLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextSize = 60})
	popTween:Play()
	popTween.Completed:Connect(function()
		local resetTween = TweenService:Create(counterLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextSize = 48})
		resetTween:Play()
	end)
end

crunchCount.Changed:Connect(updateCounter)
updateCounter()

local originalSize = butter.Size
local originalPos = butter.Position

local function playLocalAnimation()
	local squashSize = Vector3.new(1.9, 0.28, 2.7)
	local squashY = 3.9 + 0.14
	local squashPos = Vector3.new(0, squashY, 0)
	local squashTween = TweenService:Create(butter, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = squashSize,
		Position = squashPos
	})
	squashTween:Play()
	task.wait(0.18)
	local recoverTween = TweenService:Create(butter, TweenInfo.new(0.75, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = originalSize,
		Position = originalPos
	})
	recoverTween:Play()
end

local lastCount = crunchCount.Value
crunchCount.Changed:Connect(function(newValue)
	if newValue > lastCount then
		playLocalAnimation()
	end
	lastCount = newValue
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		-- ClickDetector handles server trigger for desktop and mobile taps/clicks
	end
end)
